Determine the order of interpolation and classification [S3, book].

The claim asks to determine the order of interpolation and classification. The evidence explicitly states: 'During rendering we must decide how to perform interpolation to compute the opacity and color at an arbitrary location in the volume. We could interpolate scalar value then evaluate the transfer functions, or we could evaluate the transfer functions at the grid points then interpolate the resulting opacities and colors.' It further notes that classifying at grid points (evaluating transfer functions then interpolating) is more accurate, while interpolating then classifying may appear more pleasing. Thus, the evidence supports the existence and description of these two orders.
